verdict.rationale: Lambda documents workspace firewall rules that control incoming traffic to instances, with global or per-instance rulesets, and mentions a guide for hosting a load-balanced inference API server. Together these imply ports can be exposed to serve applications. For instance-to-instance connectivity, 1-Click Clusters link nodes with GPUDirect RDMA/InfiniBand, and all cluster nodes are directly accessible, but no general private networking (VPC or private IPs) between standalone on-demand instances is documented. Missing for 10: explicit docs on opening or publishing ports to serve apps, private networking/VPC between on-demand instances, independent or hands-on corroboration.
